Sexual freedom, it's brilliant really!

At 50 I ended up single - got divorced. Sex with the wife had been dead for ages, and she reckoned it wasn't even necessary, but the real reason we split was the endless rows. After the divorce it was grand at first - peace and quiet, nobody nagging. Then I realised that rubbish sex with all the begging was still better than none at all. Main thing is, while I was married some of the women at work were throwing themselves at me, and then after - nothing. Straight up, I was gutted.

Was chatting to a lad at the garage one day. Turns out he'd had the same sort of problems, but he'd sorted them. Found this site <LINK>, he says. Young ones on there who just want a ride and prefer older blokes so nobody's looking for a ring. Hard to believe that of course, but I saved the link, and when I got home I signed up.

An hour later a message came through. Girl's 24. Writes: "Looking for an older fella. Free today?" Was a bit nervous, thought I might get robbed. Took barely any cash and headed to the motel she suggested.

She was already waiting. Legs for days. Skirt barely covering anything. Instead of a blouse she had a checked men's shirt tied up at the belly like a cowboy. No boots or hat mind you, but I was already standing to attention. And she properly threw herself at me and started snogging. First the lips, then the neck, then the chest and belly button once she'd ripped my t-shirt off. Then in one go she pulled my trousers and pants down to my ankles and buried her face in my crotch. Thought I'd finish there and then, but she stopped. Pushed me onto the bed. Took the rest of my clothes off. Climbed on top still in the skirt and shirt. Sorted me out and started bouncing away... We were at it till morning. She came loud and proper passionate. Tears even coming out of her eyes.

Now we meet up regularly. Sometimes I find others too. Sex and that's it. No rows, no demands. Life after the divorce finally feels normal.
